content:
Two days ago (the 10th), the Home Affairs Department announced the "Wozai Mountain Optimisation Plan", which will remove in phases the illegal structures that have been placed on Bishop's Hill in Sham Shui Po for many years. The first phase covers the area from the foot to the summit of the hillside rest area on Tong Yam Street, while the second phase covers the section from the foot to the summit near Beryl Street.

At present, the second-phase area still retains a number of fitness equipment and statues, and residents can be seen on site playing shuttlecock, table tennis and using the fitness equipment. As for the hillside rest area on Tong Yam Street, barbed wire and hoarding were put up last night, with security guards stationed there this morning to prohibit residents from entering.
